title: %percentile — Nth percentile (0–100)
purpose: Return the value at a given percentile of a numeric array using linear interpolation.
notes: The percentile is expressed on a 0–100 scale; 90 means the 90th percentile.
When the rank falls between two points the result is linearly interpolated.

avoid.why: %percentile expects 0–100, so 0.9 is read as the 0.9th percentile and returns a value near the minimum, not the 90th percentile; use %quantile for a 0–1 scale
